inherits: protocol_r0.json sha256 49292b006e75c1066d9df96fcc5ab9a45cfc54b714dbe3be75f4c24fbeb45918 (families, holdouts, labels, leakage, features, baselines, metrics floors)
amendments_incorporated: alignment-source gate per family locked before scores
position-block (hierarchical site) bootstrap added; both uncertainty analyses required
full metric battery; ROC-AUC alone insufficient

alignment_source_gate_frozen.fetch: UniProt REST TSV, query per family: OXDA xref:pfam-PF01266; HXK4 (xref:pfam-PF00349 AND xref:pfam-PF03727); BLAT xref:pfam-PF13354; CBS (xref:pfam-PF00571 AND xref:pfam-PF00291); PPM1D xref:pfam-PF00481; AMIE_backup xref:pfam-PF00795. All AND NOT fragment:true AND length:[0.5x to 2x of target length].
alignment_source_gate_frozen.quality_filters: exclude any sequence containing X,B,Z,J,U,O residues; exclude entries whose sequence equals the assayed target (self-exclusion); exclude close assay homologs: any sequence with best-window identity >=0.97 to the target over the assayed region
alignment_source_gate_frozen.taxonomic_sampling: stratify by superkingdom (from UniProt lineage field); cap any superkingdom at 60% of sampled pool; deterministic seed 20260922
alignment_source_gate_frozen.max_sequence_count: <=1500 pre-cluster per family; if more pass filters, deterministic seeded sample preserving the taxonomic caps
alignment_source_gate_frozen.identity_clustering_reweighting: greedy kmer3-Jaccard >=0.8 redundancy removal (seeded order, target excluded from clustering since removed); Henikoff position-based weights on surviving alignment columns; Neff = 1/sum(w_i^2) with weights normalized to sum 1
alignment_source_gate_frozen.alignment_method: EBI MAFFT REST (www.ebi.ac.uk/Tools/services/rest/mafft), default matrix, version/job ids recorded; target sequence prepended as first row; fallback if service fails after 3 retries over >=30 min: EBI Clustal Omega REST, recorded; no other aligner substitutes
alignment_source_gate_frozen.trimming_gap_rules: keep only alignment columns where the target row has a residue (target-spanning columns); drop homologs with >50% gaps across target-spanning columns post-trim
alignment_source_gate_frozen.floors: per family: >=80% of assayed positions covered by a target-spanning column with weighted occupancy >=50%; Neff >=200 effective sequences
alignment_source_gate_frozen.failure_rule: family missing either floor -> recorded non-estimable for flexibility features; AMIE backup swap permitted ONCE for one failed family; a still-failing family is scored on baselines only, flagged; no post-outcome tuning
alignment_source_gate_frozen.artifact_hashes: sha256 recorded for: fetched TSV, post-filter FASTA, submitted FASTA, raw alignment, trimmed alignment, weights vector

uncertainty_frozen.variant_bootstrap: 10,000 resamples over variant rows (as locked in R0)
uncertainty_frozen.position_block_bootstrap: 10,000 resamples over residue positions; all variants at a sampled position enter together (hierarchical dependence respected)
uncertainty_frozen.decision_rule: all-features must beat conservation-only AND profile-only with 95% CI excluding zero under BOTH bootstraps, in >=4/5 families, for BOTH ROC-AUC and PR-AUC; position- and family-balanced metrics reported alongside
uncertainty_frozen.heterogeneity: per-family effects reported individually; a single severe reversal (CI excluding zero in the negative direction) blocks an aggregate pass claim regardless of 4/5 count

locked_checks: all preprocessing/imputation/scaling/class weights fit inside each leave-one-family-out training fold only
assert: no secondary assay, duplicate target sequence, homolog >=97% identity, or target-derived profile of a held-out family enters its training fold
activity vs abundance/expression secondary assays never pooled; R1 uses primary assays only; secondary-assay transport deferred to R2 as routed

metrics per held-out family: ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, MCC and balanced accuracy at training-fold-only threshold (Youden on training), Spearman on continuous z-scores, reliability slope/intercept, ECE (10-bin), Brier, abstention coverage
baselines: conservation-only, profile-only (locked R0), plus BLOSUM-only, class-prior, and shuffled-column-label control (labels permuted within family, seed 20260922, 20 replicates)
feature ablations fit identically; the ablation comparison IS the primary question
compute_ceiling: no torch; sklearn logistic/ridge only; alignment via EBI REST; parquet streaming; all within 1GB RAM
r2_preview: if incremental value passes: within-family assay transport on frozen BLAT/OXDA/HXK4 secondary assays; if fails: close evolutionary-flexibility add-on, retain best simple baseline as the useful negative
